crown_point_on_model.alignment: 中心梯间最高45毫米范围内最前沿的顶点，对齐2015年照片冠顶两线交会。以北外墙对应的长边定向。

interpretation: Positive distances place the new surface streetward of the existing shell for a ray aimed inward. The same crown projection is applied to both independent scene levels. Along 48 flank rays beyond the width of this asset there is an existing building face. The eight existing faces at 16.8 and 17.65 m within the width but above the model shoulders are core masonry or roof; they are not modeled holes in the staircase.
